function: CSI feedback: learned compression and reconstruction of the RIS-UE channel (magnitude and phase fed back separately), exploiting correlation of nearby UEs via shared decoder and combination NN (pp. 4-7).
system: FDD downlink, passive reflecting RIS (64 or 256 elements, ULA), multi-antenna BS (Nt>>1), UEs with 1-4 antennas, no direct BS-UE link, 2.17 GHz (pp. 3, 8).
method: Autoencoder (FC layers, LSTM decoder for multi-antenna UEs) with shared co-decoder and combination NN at BS; supervised end-to-end MSE training, Adam, quantization or binarization layer (pp. 4-9).
data_channel: Dataset 1: own MATLAB multipath channels following 3GPP SCM [36], L=3-6 paths, 2.17 GHz, 100,000 CSI pairs; Dataset 2: QuaDRiGa 3GPP TR 38.901, 256-element RIS, 10,000 sets (p. 8).
test_conditions: Random split 70/10/20% train/validation/test of the same dataset; no cross-dataset or cross-scenario test reported; noisy-channel experiment varies SNR (pp. 8, 12).
baselines: Non-learned: compressive sensing (CVX). Learned: own non-cooperative autoencoder NNs (Benchmark-1 baseline, Benchmark-2 wider decoder, Benchmark-3 single-UE co-decoder), FC vs LSTM decoder; no earlier published feedback network (pp. 10-12).
metrics: NMSE (dB) of RIS-UE CSI (magnitude, phase, complex) versus bits per dimension (BPD), path number, SNR; parameter count, FLOPs, execution time; loss curve (pp. 4, 9-13).
complexity: FLOPs about 4 M; parameter counts (Fig. 12, Eq. 20; shared decoder 1.326e6 at K=2); CSI reconstruction time 2.05 ms vs 2.00 ms for benchmark (pp. 12-13).
q1_support: p. 8: "the second dataset is produced through QuaDRiGa software [46], ensuring compliance with 3GPP TR 38.901 v15.0.0 [47]"; the first dataset "is based on the 3GPP spatial channel model (SCM)".
q2_support: p. 8: "to both train and test the proposed RIS-CoCsiNet"; p. 8: "Datasets are systematically partitioned into training (70%), validation (10%), and test (20%) subsets". Held-out split of the same data, each dataset used on its own; no unseen scenario, antenna count or dataset is tested.
q3_support: p. 12: "The CS problem is addressed using the CVX toolbox" (non-learned baseline). p. 10: "Benchmark-1 denotes the baseline architecture previously illustrated in Fig. 8": the learned benchmarks are own non-cooperative variants of the proposed network; no earlier published learned feedback method is compared.
q4_support: p. 12: "the FLOP count for the proposed RIS-CoCsiNet stands at around 4 M"; p. 13: "The average execution time for the CSI reconstruction using the proposed RIS-CoCsiNet is 2.05 ms".
q5_support: p. 8: "The first set is self-created, while the second is sourced from publicly accessible software". No link or DOI to code or data; QuaDRiGa is a public simulator but the generated data are not released.
notes: Title and DOI match on p. 1. Area 2: the learned function is CSI feedback, not RIS configuration. q1 met through dataset 2 (QuaDRiGa, 3GPP TR 38.901 v15.0.0, p. 8); dataset 1 is self-created and described as based on the 3GPP SCM. q3 not met: the only non-learned baseline is CS, and benchmarks 1-3 (pp. 10-11) are the proposed network without its cooperative modules or with a wider decoder, so ablations; reviewer to confirm. q5: QuaDRiGa data are generated by the authors, not a released dataset; reviewer to confirm. The text gives both a 2.17 GHz downlink frequency and f0 = 2 GHz (p. 8).
